description: Catalog for D061. Everything is declared except the binding of the single reachable external invoke Lfixtures/External;->g()V. The entry is listed with hasClassDef=false and declared=false so the gap is explicit and intentional: the missing declaration of that one used invoke is what forces Unsupported with original debug information, while an unused gap would not. The two typed catch types Lfixtures/ErrA; and Lfixtures/ErrB; are self-made and unrelated to each other, so neither shadows the other and every declared handler priority stays reachable.

missingBinding.name: g
missingBinding.usedBy: Lfixtures/Case;->f(I)I at the try region start
missingBinding.reason: the case requires exactly one reachable external invoke whose binding catalog entry is absent
